name: Light Piercer
additional_info: Grants a Talent tool that can only be used if you have a Spear equipped. On use, fire three spear projectiles forwards, dealing 10 damage each. These cannot be blocked.
desc: While using a spear, shoot out 3 light spears that pierce through your opponent and their block. While using Familiar Prince's Armor, all passive regeneration is increased by 10%.
